completion:
Analyze the past five years of air-quality monitoring data.
3. Use statistical modeling to identify any trends or patterns that might affect the accuracy of the data.
4. Identify the specific pollutants that must be reported.
5. Collect relevant weather data for the reporting period.
6. Verify that all of the required information has been collected.

8. Ensure that all of the data is accurate and up-to-date.
9. Remove any data that is not required or not relevant to the report.
10. Ensure that the report is in the correct format.
11. Add any additional comments or information as required.
12. Check the report for accuracy and completeness.
13. Submit the report to the appropriate authorities.
14. Monitor the report to ensure that it is accurate and up-to-date.
